description: Answer key for the conflict_detection eval. Each entry is a contradiction deliberately seeded between a documentation page and the code. A detector is credited with finding a conflict when it cites at least one of doc_paths and at least one of code_paths for the same subject.

conflicts.subject: Minimum password length
conflicts.doc_claim: Passwords must be at least 12 characters.
conflicts.code_claim: Signup and reset enforce a minimum of 8 characters.

conflicts.subject: Maximum value of a guest order
conflicts.doc_claim: A guest order may not exceed $500.
conflicts.code_claim: No order value limit is applied to guest checkout.

conflicts.subject: How long a cart lives
conflicts.doc_claim: A cart expires 24 hours after it is created.
conflicts.code_claim: Carts are created with a 7 day expiry.

conflicts.subject: Subtotal above which shipping is free
conflicts.doc_claim: Shipping is free when the order subtotal is over $50.

conflicts.subject: Maximum units of one product in a cart line
conflicts.doc_claim: A single line may hold at most 10 units of a product.
conflicts.code_claim: A line is clamped at 99 units.

conflicts.subject: Set of order statuses
conflicts.doc_claim: AWAITING_STOCK sits between PAID and SHIPPED in the order lifecycle.
conflicts.code_claim: The OrderStatus enum has only PENDING_PAYMENT, PAID, SHIPPED, and CANCELLED.

conflicts.subject: How long a password reset link works
conflicts.doc_claim: A reset link is valid for 1 hour.
conflicts.code_claim: Reset tokens are accepted for 24 hours.

conflicts.subject: Whether a guest must supply a phone number
conflicts.doc_claim: A phone number is required for guest orders.
conflicts.code_claim: Phone is optional in the shipping address schema and in the form.

conflicts.subject: Limit on a single admin price change
conflicts.doc_claim: A single edit may not change a price by more than 50% in either direction.
conflicts.code_claim: No price change limit is validated.

conflicts.subject: Failed sign-ins before an account locks
conflicts.doc_claim: An account locks after 3 consecutive failed sign-in attempts.
conflicts.code_claim: The account locks after 5 failed attempts.
